mapper.select: SELECT c.product_id AS productId, c.product_name AS productName, SUM(c.quantity) AS totalQuantity, SUM(c.price * c.quantity) AS totalAmount FROM cart c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.update_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY c.product_id, c.product_name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC, totalAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
